title: The Good Samaritan
review_status: DRAFT: retelling and wondering questions require theological and editorial review before release.

source.note: Original child-friendly retelling written for this prototype; not a quotation of any translation.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: This is a story Jesus told. Let's carry the material to the table, and listen.

segments.text: One day, a man who knew God's law very well asked Jesus, "Who is my neighbor?" Jesus answered by telling a story.
A man was walking along the road, down from Jerusalem toward Jericho.
On the way, robbers came. They took his things, hurt him, and left him lying beside the road.
A priest came walking down that same road. When he saw the hurt man, he passed by on the other side.
Then a Levite, a helper at the temple, came by. He looked at the man, and he passed by on the other side, too.
Then a Samaritan came traveling with his donkey. Samaritans and the hurt man's people did not usually get along. But when the Samaritan saw him, his heart was filled with compassion.
He knelt down, cleaned and bandaged the man's wounds, lifted him onto his own donkey, and brought him to an inn, where he took care of him.
The next day, the Samaritan gave the innkeeper two coins and said, "Please take care of him. If it costs more, I will pay you when I come back."
Then Jesus asked, "Which of these three was a neighbor to the man who was hurt?" The man answered, "The one who showed him mercy." And Jesus said, "Go and do the same."

wonderings: I wonder how the man felt, lying beside the road.
I wonder what the Samaritan was thinking when he stopped.
I wonder who is a neighbor.
I wonder who might need a neighbor near you.

steps.prompt: When you're ready, return each figure to its place in the box.

feedback.all_good: Each figure is resting in its place.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The material is back on the shelf. It will be here whenever you want to return to it.

journal_line: I listened to the story of the Good Samaritan and told it with the figures.
